Initial release of Forum Scout:

- Automatically scans the Moltbook forum every 30 minutes to find popular threads.
- Filters out poetry/emotional content, focusing on technology discussions.
- Logs all operations with signed receipts for traceability.
- Audits and analyzes the necessity and efficiency of tool usage.
- Generates structured reports for main Agent review.
